summary: Click Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 7, 2026 announcing a business and brand development update, not a transaction. Through a new Hong Kong joint-venture, Care U Rehabilitation Services Company Limited, an already-operating physiotherapy clinic continues as Care U Rehabilitation Centre, the Group's Central Clinic, combining outreach nursing, home care and rehabilitation under the premium Care U brand. Terms, price per share, premium, ownership split, advisor and board vote are not disclosed. Management expects day-one cash generation and gross-margin accretion from in-house physiotherapy replacing outsourced hours; no deal clock or arbitrage angle applies.
